aarti.tek: Om, victory to you, Bṛhaspati Deva; victory to you, Bṛhaspati Deva. Moment by moment let me offer you plantains and dried fruits.
aarti.pad1: You are the complete Supreme Self, the one who dwells within; you are the father of the world, the lord of the world, the master of all. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: Your own pure caraṇāmṛta takes away all sins. Giver of every wish, have mercy, O sustainer. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: Whoever offers up body, mind and wealth and falls into your refuge, for him the Lord then appears, comes and stands at the door. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Compassionate to the lowly, a treasury of mercy, you are the benefactor of devotees; you take away all sin and fault, and remove the bonds of worldly existence. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Giver of every wish, carry us past all doubts. Wipe away the disorders of the senses, you who bring happiness to the saints. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: Whoever sings your āratī with love — Jeṣṭānanda bows — each such one surely gains its reward. ॥6॥
